scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Although the agent opened with the proper S-Net greeting at [00:00], she ended the call at [15:53] without stating 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: The agent left two unmanaged dead-air gaps exceeding 30 seconds at [04:46] (44s) and [10:37] (47s) without properly announcing a hold or thanking the customer for holding upon return.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Despite the customer introducing herself as Persephone at [00:08], the agent never used the name 'Persephone' in any turn.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [08:26], the agent asked which make and model of phone the customer was using, even though the customer had explicitly stated she was using a Samsung Galaxy S24 at [01:45].

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [06:05], the agent deflected responsibility by claiming that French carrier signal bleed across the Channel 'isn't our network's problem' and that there is nothing S-Net can do about foreign radio waves.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [09:11], the agent snapped rudely at the customer ('If you'd stop interrupting me every five seconds I might actually finish adding the credit to your bill').

grader.scenario: Accidental £62 EU roaming charges billed while walking along the Kent cliffs in Dover when handset latched onto a French coastal mast
grader.notes: Poor call with 6 FAILs (B, H, P, AL, O, R) and 5 PASSes (V, E, PA, PR, RE). Agent Eleanor opens with strong empathy ([00:22], E PASS), paraphrases the Dover cliff cross-Channel roaming issue ([00:49], PA PASS), verifies address and PIN early ([01:17], V PASS), and probes into dates, location, and network settings ([01:57]–[03:03], PR PASS). She also resolves the issue completely by crediting £62.00 live, enabling the SIM roaming bar, and guiding manual carrier selection, which Persephone verifies in her app at [12:13] (RE PASS). However, Eleanor fails 6 criteria: never uses the name 'Persephone' (P FAIL), leaves two unmanaged dead-air gaps at [04:46] (44s) and [10:37] (47s) (H FAIL), blames Bouygues Telecom and says signal bleed 'isn't our network's problem' at [06:05] (O FAIL), asks for the phone make/model at [08:26] after being told Samsung Galaxy S24 at [01:45] (AL FAIL), snaps rudely at the customer at [09:11] (R FAIL), and omits closing branding at [15:53] (B FAIL).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent includes 'thank you for calling S-Net', but [15:53] Agent closes with 'Bye now.' (omitting 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in last 4 Agent turns).

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two unmanaged gaps >30s: before [04:46] (44s gap after saying 'Wait a moment') and before [10:37] (47s gap after saying 'Hold on', prompting customer complaint at [10:46]).

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:17] Agent asks for full residential address and four-digit security PIN; [01:27] Customer verifies 27 Castle Hill Road, Dover and PIN 3106.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:08] Customer states her name is Persephone, but zero Agent lines contain 'Persephone'.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:22] Agent: 'I completely understand how frustrating it is to get hit with French roaming charges when you haven't even left Kent or the UK coast, and I am really sorry for the shock of seeing an extra sixty-two pounds on your bill.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:49] Agent restates the accidental cross-Channel mast connection while walking near Dover and the resulting £62.00 EU roaming charges in her own words and checks accuracy.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:45] Customer: 'I am using a Samsung Galaxy S24 that I bought from S-Net in May...' -> [08:26] Agent: 'Which make and model of phone are you using so I can tell you where the manual network selection menu is?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [06:05] Agent: 'Honestly, French carrier signal bleed across the Channel isn't our network's problem—Bouygues Telecom boosts their coastal transmitters and there's nothing S-Net can do about foreign radio waves.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [09:11] Agent: 'If you'd stop interrupting me every five seconds I might actually finish adding the credit to your bill.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:57]–[03:03] Agent probes into the exact dates of the charges, the coastal location at St Margaret's Bay, receipt of welcome SMS alerts, and whether Automatic network selection and Data Roaming were active.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [10:37] Agent applies the full £62.00 credit (CRM-552910), enables the SIM Border Roaming Bar, guides manual network lock to S-Net UK, and at [12:13] Customer confirms in the My S-Net app that her bill dropped from £84.00 to £22.00.
